checks.message: Provisional geometry is retained unchanged and disclosed as non-official in every display layer.
All three key areas remain provisional; station and road anchoring limitations are explicit.
The authoring agent declares zero site visits and makes no field-verified claim.
The authoring agent declares zero resident interviews; personas remain hypotheses and public feedback is not generalized.
Six partitions cover the submitted site with shared boundaries and no material overlap.
Spatial areas and ratios are recalculated in EPSG:4548 from the submitted geometry.
All 12 scenario cards state role, affected users, resources, baseline, window, success threshold, stop threshold and fallback.
Every scenario preserves a staffed, physical or paper fallback.
Narrative, report, visual page, five figures and both drawing sets have English counterparts.
The visualization is offline, responsive and contains no remote dependencies.
No third-party photographs, tiles, logos or remote fonts are distributed.
Required standards, design-depth items, sources, geometry and metrics have structured audit references.
